text:
maya: Quick Q from trip to Berlin — paid some taxis in cash and added tips in cash. Receipts are just tiny paper slips with no VAT line and sometimes no merchant name. Can I still get reimbursed? Also saw VAT on hotel folio — do we reclaim VAT or is that on me?
hr-ops: Hi @maya — short answers: yes for taxi cash as long as you include a legible photo of the receipt + the trip details, and VAT on hotels depends on country and expense type. 
maya: ok what counts as "trip details"? driver name? route? I have times and total only.
finance-amy: For taxis we need: date, amount, currency, and any identifier (driver name or plate or app booking id). If merchant name missing, add a short note in the expense line: e.g., "Taxi Tegel -> Mitte, 8/Mar, driver Ivan, cash tip €2". 
maya: cool. And the cash tip — are we okay reimbursing that? or should I have added tip on card?
finance-amy: Cash tips are reimbursable up to local custom; record them as separate line item labeled "tip". We ask you to avoid inflating tips — keep them reasonable.
tom: for VAT: if the invoice/folio lists VAT separately and it's recoverable (generally B2B hotel VAT in EU), Finance will identify reclaimable VAT when you submit through Expensify. If it looks like VAT is embedded (no separate VAT line), we treat total as non-recoverable and reimburse net.
maya: what about trains/ferries where agent gave me a handwritten receipt — will that pass?
finance-amy: Handwritten receipts are accepted if legible and include date, amount, operator. For rail, show origin/destination and fare. If it's ambiguous, add a brief note.
maya: any difference for cash expenses above some threshold? like >€75?
hr-ops: No different rule by amount for cash, but card payments are preferred for traceability. For anything >€250 we require manager approval + proof of business purpose.
maya: is there a preferred exchange rate if I paid in local currency and the card statement shows GBP later? I paid cash in EUR.
finance-amy: Use the exchange rate on the date of the expense. Our expense system will attempt to auto-convert; if you think the conversion on your bank statement is better, attach the bank/card statement line and add a note. For cash, add the conversion you used (source e.g., Google rate on 2026-03-08) and attach screenshot.
maya: About VAT reclaim — will I be contacted if Finance reclaims VAT or do I need to do anything?
finance-amy: Finance handles VAT reclaim centrally. If we need extra docs (original invoice, guest folio), we'll ping you. No action needed unless we ask.
finance-bot: Automated reminder: attach one photo per receipt (preferred), include currency field, and tag expenses with project code if applicable. Claims submitted by 17:00 PT on Friday processed within 3 business days.
maya: last: I have a hotel folio with separate city tax charged by municipality — is that reimbursable?
finance-amy: City/tourist taxes are reimbursable when it is a mandatory local levy for business stays. If it's optional (e.g., "resort fee" bundled with amenities) we review case-by-case. Add a note when you submit.
maya: Thanks all — will upload receipts now and mark expense lines with notes as suggested. :thumbsup:
